title: Ship pushes again once the operator unlocks Bitwarden and bw serve runs
body:
Since 2026-11-17 04:28 the transient unit bw-serve.service (systemd-run, 10 h RuntimeMaxSec) is stopped and `bw status` is locked, so `krn pr ship` and `krn task publish` fail: `push failed: github-app-token: bw serve unavailable at http://localhost:8087`. Unlocking needs the operator's master password (credential grant, not agent-recoverable). Waiting locally: worktree .krn/worktrees/s7-closeout (commit closing t-1p7dmw9) and pending task records on refs/krn/pending-tasks.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts
Outcome: `curl -s localhost:8087/status` reports unlocked and `krn pr ship --worktree .krn/worktrees/s7-closeout ...` prints `verdict: merged`.
Proof: krn pr ship on the s7-closeout worktree exits 0 with a verdict: merged line.
